witness.note: witness is the recomputed finite object: the exact gap multiset of squarefree s_{n+1}-s_n for s_n <= N, regenerated deterministically inside the verifier (no trusted data, no I/O). The verifier is a pure function returning True only on full exact success, raising/failing closed otherwise.

run.detail: verifier exceeded 300s — a verifier that does not terminate has not verified anything

claim: RESULT == True certifies the D2 fragment: the exact integer/Fraction per-gap verifier for squarefree gaps s_{n+1}-s_n with 1<=g<=33, n<=10^7, 0<=alpha<=4 succeeds fail-closed (pure function, require-raise, no floats, no I/O, exact arithmetic, abort on any gap outside the certified range), confirming the staircase identity g^alpha = sum_j Delta_j 1_{g>=j} exactly on the certified finite range; the analytic tail g>33 / n>10^7 remains open and is NOT covered.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
